summary: The VERDICT is unchanged from v2 — Gate M cannot be decided from the aggregated table, because blocked_date folds do not exist in it. The NUMBERS are superseded: review found that v2's evaluated model still was not the deployed one, so its diagnostic figures described a model the project does not ship. v2 is preserved unedited; its measured_under_v2 block should not be quoted.

why_v2_numbers_are_superseded.one_model_per_city_instead_of_per_statio: Deployment (dirsplit/train.py) trains a separate locally weighted model for each target sensor, centred on that sensor's own feature vector, and its own leave-city-out validation does the same for each held-out station. v2's held_out_predictions fit ONE model per fold, centred on the mean of the whole held-out city. That is a different estimator, and the difference is largest exactly where the kernel is doing work. Fixed: held_out_predictions now groups the test side by station_id and fits one model per held-out station, in sorted order so every candidate still pools rows in the same order and the paired bootstrap stays valid.
why_v2_numbers_are_superseded.the_nested_shrinkage_reused_the_wrong_ce: v2 fit lambda by a nested leave-city-out on the training side, but re-used the OUTER fold's single centre for every inner prediction. Deployment pools inner predictions that each came from a model weighted toward THEIR OWN held-out station. So v2 calibrated lambda for a model that was not the one being shrunk. Fixed: _fit_shrinkage takes a {station: centre} map and re-centres per inner held-out station.
why_v2_numbers_are_superseded.numerical_warnings: The real v2 run emitted divide-by-zero, overflow and invalid-value warnings from the similarity kernel and the shrinkage regression. The output happened to be finite and the report happened to reproduce, but 'happened to' is not a property. Fixed with explicit floors (MIN_BANDWIDTH, MAX_KERNEL_EXPONENT, MIN_SHRINKAGE_DENOMINATOR), a finiteness check on the weights, a uniform-weight fallback when no training row resembles the target, and a finite-only shrinkage regression. The run below completed under `python3 -W error::RuntimeWarning` with no warning raised.

measured_under_v3.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. The gate is INCONCLUSIVE, so none of these numbers decides anything; they are recorded so the next run has a reference point.
measured_under_v3.observation: Under the corrected per-station deployment-equivalent fit, the LightGBM candidate is still worse than 50/50 on leave-city-out (CI95 entirely above zero) and indistinguishable on leave-station-out. The per-station correction moved it from -4.7% to -3.3% on leave-city-out, i.e. the earlier figure overstated the loss. The two hierarchical D-factor candidates beat 50/50 on leave-city-out and tie on leave-station-out. None of this promotes anything: rule 4 requires the win under every fold kind, and rule 6 has already returned INCONCLUSIVE for the missing one.
measured_under_v3.caveat: Even this is not exactly deployment. Deployment fits on ALL cities at once and predicts Gothenburg; a leave-city-out fold necessarily withholds one city's rows. The estimator and the weighting now match; the training population per fold cannot, by construction.

provenance.note: The report now carries a full content_key over its own payload plus digests of the training table and of the evaluate/train/dataset/features modules, so a stale report is distinguishable from a current one. v1 and v2 had neither.

what_would_decide_it.requirement: dataset v2 as described in the plan's 'Dataset v2' section: one row per station_id x local_date x hour x heading, with raw toward/away counts and a stable day_block_id, so blocked_date folds exist and blocks become station x date.
what_would_decide_it.blocker_in_this_environment: dirsplit/dataset.py rebuilds the table from raw Statens vegvesen volumes, which are gitignored and re-fetched from trafikkdata-api.atlas.vegvesen.no. That host is denied by this session's policy-enforcing egress proxy.
what_would_decide_it.not_a_workaround: Synthesising dates, or splitting the aggregate table on any proxy for time, would fabricate the exact evidence the gate is asking for. Left undone.

consequence: Fas 2, Fas 3 and Fas 4 remain closed. Gate M is neither BASELINE nor MODEL.
